Be Part of Something
Extraordinary

Odyssey is comprised of top talent in biotech, pharma and academia. We’re driven, passionate and hard-working. Our teams are fearless in taking on problems that might discourage others. If you’re ready to drive progress alongside some of the industry’s best minds in inflammatory and autoimmune treatment, then come join us.

Joining Our Team

Benefits and Beyond

Our comprehensive benefits are designed to fit individual needs, recognizing that each team member is important to Odyssey’s success. We are powered by strong values and are passionate about providing resources that support employee growth and development.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Prescription coverage
  • Health savings account with company contribution
  • Dependent care account
  • Life insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Flexible time off
  • Mentoring and career development programs
  • Ability to work across company sites in US and Europe

Benefits vary by region.

EXPLORE CAREER OPPORTUNITIES

Notice on Fraudulent Job Offers

Odyssey Therapeutics has recently learned of a recruitment fraud involving scammers posing as company recruiters, or falsely claiming to represent employees of Odyssey Therapeutics.

What is Recruitment Fraud?

Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam offering fake job opportunities to job seekers. This type of fraud is normally carried out through online platforms such as false websites or through fake emails claiming to be from the company. The purpose of this fraud is to obtain personal information (e.g. name, social security number), bank account, or credit card information from victims as part of the fictitious onboarding process. Odyssey Therapeutics, Inc., and its affiliates (“Odyssey”) do not require any financial expenditures by candidates in connection with the employment process.

Identifying Legitimate Odyssey Job Postings and/or Recruitment Process

  • All valid, open positions are posted on https://odysseytx.com/careers
    • You may come across job postings on various job boards. For your safety, please verify the role exists by going to our careers page
  • Any employment-related communications that are not from @odysseytx.com or @hibob.com should be treated as fraudulent.
  • Our hiring managers and external recruiting firms will not ask for sensitive personal information, money, or payments at any point in the recruitment process

If you believe that you have been a victim of a fraudulent job offer, please contact us via security⁠-⁠alerts@odysseytx.com with “fraudulent job offer” in the subject line.
